Thanks again for taking the time today — good first pass on scope and constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep dive with our ML + infra leads:

- Stakeholders you mentioned: Alex (product), Sam (data), and one infra owner to join.

Please share:
1) Who from your side should be on the call (we need one infra engineer + product/data);
2) Any absolute blackout windows next week;
3) Preference for a 60 vs 90 minute timebox.

Suggested availability (all times PT):
- Option A: Tue 2028-07-02 10:00–11:30 (90m)
- Option B: Wed 2028-07-03 13:00–14:00 (60m)

If you prefer, pick a slot via our Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/tdx-90min

Attached: tdx-draft-agenda.pdf (brief), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (we filled initial owners).

Thanks — I can book once you confirm roster + preferred slot.

— Rishi
